Item.Name: S_START_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter start date of the schedule in MMDDYY format.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_sysdate date;
 v_local_time date;
begin 
nullchk_trg ; check_package_failure ;

 -- time zone change --04/09/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if; 

if :control_block.s_start_date < trunc(v_sysdate)-:param_sspst then
 show_error('12101') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
:start_day := to_char(:control_block.s_start_date,'DY') ;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 sch_period number ;
begin
nullchk_trg ; check_package_failure ;
begin
 select to_number(parameter_value) into sch_period
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'STPRD'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
exception
 when no_data_found then sch_period := 7 ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;
/*-- Check if start date is less than end date --*/
if :control_block.s_end_date < :control_block.s_start_date then
 :global.failed_item := :system.trigger_item ;
 show_error('12123') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;

/*-- Check if scheduling period is 7 days (parameterized) --*/

if (:control_block.s_end_date - :control_block.s_start_date)+1 != sch_period then
 :global.failed_item := :system.trigger_item ;
 show_error('12136') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;

if :control_block.s_start_date is not null and :control_block.s_end_date is not null then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from staff_schedule_hdr
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and start_date = :control_block.s_start_date
 and end_date = :control_block.s_end_date
 and rownum = 1 ;
 show_error('12138') ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

:end_day := to_char(:control_block.s_end_date,'DY') ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 total_time integer ;
 hours varchar2(2) ;
 minutes varchar2(2) ;
 seconds varchar2(2) ;
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date; 
begin 
 :control_block.s_start_date := :control_block.s_start_date ;
 :control_block.s_end_date := :control_block.s_end_date ;
 :dummy.s_schedule_id := :dummy.s_schedule_id ;
 validate(form_scope) ; 
 if form_failure then
 go_item(:global.failed_item) ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;

 begin 
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from staff_schedule_hdr
 where (:control_block.s_start_date between start_date and end_date
 or :control_block.s_end_date between start_date and end_date)
 and start_date != :control_block.s_start_date
 and status != 'CANCL'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1 ;

 show_error('12220') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 null ;
 when others then 
 handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 --time zone change--02-16-11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :control_block.s_start_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :control_block.s_start_time := sysdate;
 end if; 

 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :control_block.s_end_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :control_block.s_end_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 --:s_start_time := sysdate ; 
 :msg_item := 'Staff Scheduling in progress' ; 
 --pitss synchronize;
 don_staff_schedule.main_proc(:control_block.s_start_date,:control_block.s_end_date,
 :dummy.s_schedule_id,:global.chapter_id,:dummy.schedule_name) ;
 check_package_failure ; 
 --:s_end_time := sysdate ; 
 :msg_item := 'Scheduling Complete' ; 
 
 total_time := (:s_end_time - :s_start_time)*24*60*60 ;
 hours := lpad(to_char(floor(total_time / 3600)),2,'0') ;
 minutes := lpad(to_char(floor((total_time - to_number(hours)*3600) / 60)),2,'0');
 seconds := lpad(to_char(total_time - hours*3600 - minutes*60),2,'0');
 :process_time := hours||':'||minutes||':'||seconds ; 
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PERIOD_SUMMARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_period_summary (p_start_date in date,p_end_date in date) IS
 curdate date := p_start_date ;
 total_staff number := 0 ;
 v_date date;
BEGIN
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 message('Working...',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);

 if p_start_date is null or p_end_date is null then 
 return ;
 end if ;

 go_block('PERIOD_SUMMARY') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block ;
 loop
 :summary_date := curdate ;
 :summary_day := to_char(curdate,'DY') ;
 begin
 select count(*) into :drive_count
 from drives
 where drive_date = curdate
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM' ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select sum(number_reqd) into :est_staff
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id in ( select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = curdate
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM')
 and resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select count(*) into total_staff
 from employees
 where emp_class = 'MSTAF'
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select count(*) into :unavl_staff
 from staff_off_day
 where unavail_date = curdate 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :avl_staff := total_staff - :unavl_staff ;
 next_record ;
 curdate := curdate + 1 ;
 if curdate > p_end_date then
 exit ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 first_record ;
 clear_message ;
END;
